en:
## New Features

- **In-browser file editor with a file tree**: files are written against an allow-list rooted at the workspace, with optimistic locking and encoding preservation. Saving captures its own snapshot boundary, so edits made by a human outside the tool window are never rolled back by a later tool revert
- **Plugin capability management**: grants can be viewed, revoked and added from the plugin detail page; a call to an un-granted capability now creates a reviewable pending request that an admin approves or denies
- **Plugin upgrades no longer silently expand permissions**: capabilities newly declared by an updated manifest are held back as pending approval requests instead of being merged into the grant set — the upgrade itself still applies
- **local-process plugins run without installing Bun**: the compiled single-file build bootstraps its own embedded runtime (Windows included), removing the "install Bun or hit a lock conflict" failure mode
- **Real-time plugin state**: status changes are pushed over the socket with foreground polling as a fallback, so panel data stays fresh without manual refreshes
- **Narrator public API for plugins**: list narrators, send them messages and interrupt them, powering plugins that delegate work to narrators (such as Narrator Team)
- **Background device transfers**: TransferFile supports running in the background with pause/resume, structured progress, and resumption after a server restart
- **Scheduled task tool**: narrators can schedule actions to run later
- **Narrator typography settings**: font size, letter spacing, line height and paragraph spacing as percentage presets, fed into the message-height measurement model
- **Usage history distinguishes external requests** (external kind + agent label, including DeepSeek Harness imports)

## Bug Fixes

- **Anthropic sessions lost their identity on every turn**: the session id changed per request and the device id was regenerated per process, so a proxy would spread one conversation across upstream credentials and miss the prompt cache each turn. Now synced to Claude Code protocol 2.1.251 with a stable per-conversation session id and a persistent device id
- **A missing default model no longer masquerades as a different error**: the hardcoded fallback is gone, replaced by a clear 503 with setup guidance; the setup wizard picks the model before the assistant runs
- **Queueing "send with the next request" actually takes effect while the stream is running** instead of two requests later; side questions open an answer panel in the dock instead of navigating away and losing scroll position and drafts
- **Terminal processes now own a controlling terminal**: sudo/ssh/gpg can prompt for input, closing a terminal no longer leaks orphan processes, and one-click dependency install routes sudo password prompts to an interactive terminal
- **A growing permission form no longer permanently detaches chat auto-scroll**: expanding feedback fields no longer leaves every new message landing off-screen
- **Several plugin panel render loops and the iframe interaction deadlock are fixed**, and contribution lists are filtered by the host surface (workspace views no longer appear where no workspace exists)
- **Browsing huge directories no longer freezes the UI** (scan caps with truncation notices on the file-tree paths)
- **Tutorial lessons after the first one are reachable again**: the tutorial narrator is now reused across courses instead of hitting the one-primary-narrator-per-chapter limit
- **The .git directory is write-protected against file tools** (including symlink tricks), closing the pre-commit hook injection path
- Date formatting follows the UI language (key reset times, certificate expiry), and array-valued i18n resources are validated again instead of silently skipped
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- **浏览器内文件编辑与文件树**：文件写入以工作区为根做白名单把关，带乐观锁与编码保留。保存文件即自动取一次快照边界，人在工具窗口之外做的编辑不会再被后续的工具回退误伤
- **插件能力授权管理面板**：可在插件详情页查看、吊销或手动补充授权；调用未授权能力时会生成可审阅的待批准请求，由管理员批准后生效
- **插件升级不再静默扩权**：新版本清单新增的能力会扣留为待批准请求，而不是自动并入授权集；升级本身照常生效
- **local-process 插件无需安装 Bun**：编译版（单文件 exe）自带运行时自举，Windows 上也不再要求另装 bun 或遭遇实例锁冲突
- **插件状态实时刷新**：状态变化即时推送、前台轮询兜底，面板数据无需手动刷新
- **插件可用的 narrator 公共 API**：查询叙述者列表、发送消息与中断会话，支撑 Narrator Team 这类把任务派发给叙述者的插件
- **后台设备传输**：TransferFile 支持后台运行——可暂停/恢复，带结构化进度，服务器重启后可续传
- **定时任务工具**：叙述者可以安排稍后执行的动作
- **叙述者排版自定义**：字号、字距、行高、段距四个百分比设置，贯穿消息排版的高度测量模型
- **用量历史区分外部请求**：新增 external 类型与 agentLabel 标注（含 DeepSeek Harness 导入的外部请求）

## 修复

- **Anthropic 会话身份逐轮丢失**：session id 每轮变化、device id 随进程重生，中转会把同一会话打散到多个上游凭据、每轮错失 prompt cache。现已同步 Claude Code 协议 2.1.251，会话 id 按会话稳定派生、设备标识持久化
- **默认模型缺失不再伪装成别的错误**：删除硬编码回退，改为明确的 503 与配置指引；安装向导改为先选模型再让助手运行
- **插队在流式阶段就真正生效**，不再拖到下下次请求；顺带提问的答案改为 dock 内面板展示，不再跳页丢失滚动位置与草稿
- **终端进程现在真正拥有控制终端**：sudo/ssh/gpg 可以交互提示；关闭终端不再泄漏孤儿进程；一键安装依赖遇到 sudo 密码时会把用户引导到可输入密码的终端
- **权限弹窗不再打断聊天自动跟随**：反馈输入框展开把弹窗撑高时，后续消息不再永久落在屏幕外
- **修复多个插件面板渲染死循环与 iframe 交互死锁**；插件面板选择列表按宿主表面过滤（workspace 视图不再出现在没有工作区的页面）
- **浏览超大目录不再卡死界面**（文件树各路径补上扫描上限与截断提示）
- **教程第二课起重新可达**：教程叙述者改为跨课程复用，不再受「每章只能一个主叙述者」限制
- **.git 目录对文件工具不可写**（含 symlink 绕过），堵住 pre-commit hook 注入路径
- 日期显示跟随界面语言（重置时间、证书到期日等），数组型 i18n 资源重新纳入校验而非静默跳过
